regulations_cn.issuing_authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of the PRC
regulations_cn.title_original: 在中国境内就业的外国人参加社会保险暂行办法
regulations_cn.title_english: Interim Measures for the Participation in Social Insurance by Foreigners Employed in China (MoHRSS Order No. 16)
regulations_cn.legal_reference_number: MoHRSS Order No. 16 (人力资源和社会保障部令第16号)
regulations_cn.summary: Mandates that foreigners legally employed within the territory of China must participate in the five statutory social insurances: Basic Pension, Basic Medical Insurance, Work-related Injury Insurance, Unemployment Insurance, and Maternity Insurance.
key_provisions: Article 3: Employers recruiting foreigners shall complete social insurance registration within 30 days of obtaining employment certificates.
Article 4: Both employer and foreign employee shall make monthly social insurance contributions pursuant to statutory rates.
Article 9: Social insurance agreements between China and foreign countries shall govern exemption from specific contributions (bilateral treaty reciprocity).
applicable_population: Legally employed foreign nationals holding Work Permit in China

regulations_cn.issuing_authority: Ministry of Education, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Public Security
regulations_cn.title_original: 学校招收和培养国际学生管理办法
regulations_cn.title_english: Provisions on the Administration of the Enrollment and Cultivation of International Students by Schools (Joint Order No. 42)
regulations_cn.legal_reference_number: MoE, MFA, MPS Joint Order No. 42 (教育部、外交部、公安部令第42号)
regulations_cn.summary: Requires that all international students studying at schools in China must purchase comprehensive medical insurance covering accidental injury and inpatient hospitalization.
key_provisions: Article 41: Schools shall implement an international student insurance system. International students must purchase comprehensive medical insurance in accordance with national regulations.
Article 41: Schools shall not register or enroll international students who fail to purchase the required comprehensive medical insurance.

regulations_cn.title_english: Shenzhen Medical Security Measures (Shenzhen Municipal Gov Order No. 358)
regulations_cn.legal_reference_number: Shenzhen Municipal Order No. 358 (深圳市人民政府令第358号)
regulations_cn.summary: Establishes Shenzhen municipal basic medical insurance into First-tier (Tier 1, comprehensive individual account and pool fund) and Second-tier (Tier 2, municipal pool fund for inpatient and outpatient capitation).
key_provisions: Employees with employment relations in Shenzhen participate in Tier 1 or Tier 2 based on employer registration.
Tier 1 participants may use personal medical accounts for outpatient pharmacy and family member health expenses.
Community Health Centers (社康中心) provide primary outpatient consultations with preferential 75% to 90% reimbursement.
applicable_population: Foreign employees participating in Shenzhen social insurance

regulations_cn.issuing_authority: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
regulations_cn.title_original: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
regulations_cn.title_english: Personal Information Protection Law of the PRC (PIPL)
regulations_cn.legal_reference_number: Presidential Order No. 91 (中华人民共和国主席令第九十一号)
regulations_cn.summary: China's foundational personal information protection statute, classifying medical and financial insurance data as Sensitive Personal Information requiring separate consent and security impact assessments.
key_provisions: Article 28: Biometric, medical health, financial accounts, and personal tracking are Sensitive Personal Information.
Article 29: Processing sensitive personal information requires specific necessity and separate consent from the individual.
Article 39: Cross-border transfer of personal information requires statutory compliance mechanisms (CAC security assessment, certification, or standard contract).
applicable_population: Entities processing personal information in China
Insurance platforms handling health and claim data

regulations_id.issuing_authority: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat dan Presiden Republik Indonesia
regulations_id.title_original: Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional
regulations_id.title_english: Law No. 40 Year 2004 on the National Social Security System (UU SJSN)
regulations_id.summary: Foundational statute establishing the principles of mandatory social security, mutual cooperation (gotong royong), non-profit operation, and universal health security for all residents of Indonesia.
key_provisions: Pasal 19: Health security is implemented on the principle of social insurance and equity, ensuring comprehensive medical benefits.
Pasal 22: Health security benefits are intended to maintain and enhance the health degree of participants and their family members.
applicable_population: Foreigners residing and working for at least 6 months

regulations_id.title_original: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 59 Tahun 2024 tentang Perubahan Ketiga atas Peraturan Presiden Nomor 82 Tahun 2018 tentang Jaminan Kesehatan
regulations_id.title_english: Presidential Regulation No. 59 Year 2024 on Health Security (Perpres JKN 2024)
regulations_id.summary: Regulates the implementation of Standard Inpatient Classes (Kelas Rawat Inap Standar - KRIS), service referral mechanisms, contribution tiers, and comprehensive list of excluded medical procedures under JKN BPJS Kesehatan.
key_provisions: Pasal 46: Implementation of KRIS minimum hospital facility criteria across all participating JKN partner hospitals.
Pasal 52: Exhaustive statutory exclusions list from JKN benefits (aesthetic surgery, non-referral non-emergencies, overseas care, injuries from intoxication).
applicable_population: Healthcare provider facilities (FKTP and FKRTL) in Indonesia

regulations_id.title_original: Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 22 Tahun 2023 tentang Pelindungan Konsumen dan Masyarakat di Sektor Jasa Keuangan
regulations_id.title_english: OJK Regulation No. 22 Year 2023 on Consumer Protection in Financial Services (POJK 22/2023)
regulations_id.summary: Mandates transparency, fair treatment, clear policy wording disclosure (RIPLAY), and internal dispute resolution standards for licensed insurance companies operating in Indonesia.
key_provisions: Pasal 14: Insurers must deliver accurate, balanced, and understandable Product and Service Information Summary (RIPLAY) prior to policy contracting.
Pasal 38: Financial service businesses must handle consumer complaints within a maximum of 10 working days (extendable by 10 working days for complex cases).
applicable_population: Licensed commercial insurance companies in Indonesia

regulations_id.issuing_authority: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat dan Presiden Republik Indonesia
regulations_id.title_original: Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia Nomor 27 Tahun 2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi
regulations_id.title_english: Law No. 27 Year 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP)
regulations_id.summary: Indonesia's comprehensive data privacy statute, defining health data, biometrics, and personal financial data as Specific Personal Data requiring explicit consent and high-standard data governance.
key_provisions: Pasal 4 ayat (2): Health data and information, genetic data, and personal financial data are Specific Personal Data (Data Pribadi yang Bersifat Spesifik).
Pasal 20: Processing of personal data requires valid legal basis, including explicit consent from the data subject for specified purposes.
applicable_population: Data controllers and data processors handling personal data of Indonesian residents

schemes_cn.scheme_name_original: 城镇职工基本医疗保险 (UEBMI)
schemes_cn.administrator: National Healthcare Security Administration (NHSA) and local municipal HSA bureaus

membership_categories.label: Employed worker (domestic and foreign holding work permit)
Retired employee meeting minimum contribution years

schemes_cn.contribution_rules: Jointly contributed by employer (approx 6% to 8% of wage base) and employee (2% of wage base deducted via payroll).
benefit_summary: Inpatient hospitalization coverage up to local annual ceiling (often RMB 500,000+ depending on municipality)
Personal medical account (个人账户) funded by employee contribution for outpatient consultations and pharmacy
Catastrophic illness supplemental insurance (大病保险) automatically linked to high medical costs
schemes_cn.referral_requirements: Direct access to contracted public medical institutions (定点医疗机构). Referral required for inter-provincial direct billing (跨省异地就医直接结算备案).
administrative_procedures: Employer submits registration to local Social Insurance Bureau within 30 days of hiring.
Employee receives Social Security Card (社保卡) or activates Digital Health Insurance Code (医保电子凭证).

schemes_id.scheme_name_original: Program Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional (JKN / BPJS Kesehatan)
schemes_id.scheme_name_english: National Health Insurance Program (JKN BPJS Kesehatan)
schemes_id.administrator: Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial Kesehatan (BPJS Kesehatan)

membership_categories.label: Penerima Bantuan Iuran Jaminan Kesehatan (Subsidized vulnerable population paid by APBN/APBD)
Pekerja Penerima Upah (Formal employees in government, state-owned enterprises, and private companies)
Pekerja Bukan Penerima Upah / Peserta Mandiri (Self-employed and independent workers)
Bukan Pekerja (Investors, pensioners, and non-employed residents)

schemes_id.contribution_rules: PPU: 5% of monthly wage (4% employer, 1% employee, salary cap IDR 12,000,000). PBPU Mandiri: Flat monthly premium per member according to class (Kelas 1: IDR 150k, Kelas 2: IDR 100k, Kelas 3: IDR 35k).
benefit_summary: Comprehensive primary medical care at registered FKTP clinic (Puskesmas / Dokter Praktik / Klinik Pratama)
Specialist outpatient consultation and surgical inpatient hospital care at FKRTL with electronic referral
Emergency medical services at any hospital Emergency Department (IGD) without prior referral
Essential medicine coverage pursuant to Formularium Nasional (Fornas)
schemes_id.referral_requirements: Strict tiered referral system (Sistem Rujukan Berjenjang) through primary care clinic (FKTP). Direct hospital visits without emergency or referral are non-reimbursable.
administrative_procedures: Register online via Mobile JKN application, Pandawa WhatsApp (08118165165), or BPJS branch office.
Select and register one designated primary care clinic (FKTP) in neighborhood of residence.
Display digital KIS card in Mobile JKN application or present NIK KTP during medical check-in.
